_comment: Which breeder network serves a user, based on the city they pick in Q3.
We have verified breeders in Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore and Pune.
Everyone else is routed to the nearest network AND told plainly that it is
not their own city — we never pretend a Delhi user has local breeders.
EDITABLE: when a new city network goes live, add its sheet name to
`networks`, list the quiz-city names that count as local in `localCities`,
and move the surrounding cities into `nearest`. Anything unlisted falls to
_localComment: Quiz-city names that ARE the network's own city (so no 'not your city' notice). The quiz says 'Bengaluru'; the breeder sheet is titled 'Bangalore'. Secunderabad is part of Hyderabad.
_nearestComment: Cities routed to each network by rough road proximity. Western Tamil Nadu (Salem, Coimbatore, Erode, Ooty) sits closer to Bengaluru than to Chennai, and Hosur is effectively a Bengaluru suburb. Nagpur is far eastern Maharashtra, so it goes to Hyderabad rather than Pune.
